title: Tabkeeper Interest script output
description: The value of an Interest script's last expression, with Rhai values mapped to JSON (() is null). See `script::to_output`. The app is more lenient than this schema: it accepts any value in any field. The schema rejects only what is almost certainly a mistake: a map or array in a text field, and unknown fields, which the app ignores.

text.description: Stored as a string. () is "". Cut to 2000 characters plus '…'.
A change counts as an update, unless `key` is set.

key.description: If set, an update is reported exactly when `key` changes; items and text are not diffed. () means unset. Not cut to 2000 characters.

items.description: () entries are dropped, then the first 200 are kept. () is no items.

id.description: Stable identity used to detect new items. If empty, the first non-empty of `url`, `title`, `text`.
